events.status: FDA approval (2022); voluntary US/CA market withdrawal path after Phase 3 PHOENIX miss (2024)
events.note: Phase 2 promise → Phase 3 primary/secondary miss — graft risk on accelerated path

events.status: FDA accelerated approval for SOD1-ALS; EMA path public 2024-class reporting
events.note: Subset only (~SOD1). Presymptomatic ATLAS and sporadic exploration are separate debates

events.status: Examples: FUS ASO jacifusen Phase 3-class; pridopidine PREVAiLS Phase 3 cleared; SPG302 EAP; multiple SOD1/C9orf72 genetic programs

P2_constraint_bottom.description: Bottom-up constraints under model M — parallel residual surface, not Seal
constraints: Motor neuron loss is largely irreversible in time already elapsed for symptomatic patients
Phenotype heterogeneity (familial vs sporadic; gene subset vs broad) forbids one-molecule universal claim
Endpoints (ALSFRS-R, survival, NfL) are residual meters — not identity with patient meaning
Any modality must declare target class and population or fail floor test
Accelerated approval without confirmatory success is a known graft risk (Relyvrio/PHOENIX pattern)
graft_notes: P1 approvals sit on incomplete pathogenesis maps
Genetic ASO success does not transfer to all ALS without new evidence
P2 refuses cure language on Open face; Depth packs only under residual cost when live
P2_constraint_bottom.matrix_status: Public M pack pending — dual column only
